## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A gap seen in one interactive session and three autopilot sessions of the...

The system SHALL ensure that a gap seen in one interactive session and three autopilot sessions of the same change does not graduate; the same gap seen in two distinct changes does (asserted by test).

#### Scenario: A gap seen in one interactive session and three autopilot sessions of the...

WHEN `add-gap-and-rejection-ledgers-to-improve-harness` is implemented
THEN A gap seen in one interactive session and three autopilot sessions of the same change does not graduate; the same gap seen in two distinct changes does (asserted by test).

### Requirement: A gap whose text is covered by a newly added instruction unit is retired on...

The system SHALL ensure that a gap whose text is covered by a newly added instruction unit is retired on the next run, and a gap unseen for 90 days is expired.

#### Scenario: A gap whose text is covered by a newly added instruction unit is retired on...

WHEN `add-gap-and-rejection-ledgers-to-improve-harness` is implemented
THEN A gap whose text is covered by a newly added instruction unit is retired on the next run, and a gap unseen for 90 days is expired.

### Requirement: A rejected edit key is not re-proposed on a rerun with identical evidence...

The system SHALL ensure that a rejected edit key is not re-proposed on a rerun with identical evidence and is re-proposed when one additional qualifying session backs it.

#### Scenario: A rejected edit key is not re-proposed on a rerun with identical evidence...

WHEN `add-gap-and-rejection-ledgers-to-improve-harness` is implemented
THEN A rejected edit key is not re-proposed on a rerun with identical evidence and is re-proposed when one additional qualifying session backs it.

### Requirement: The report prints relevance per instruction id split by interactive and...

The system SHALL ensure that the report prints relevance per instruction id split by interactive and non-interactive sessions.

#### Scenario: The report prints relevance per instruction id split by interactive and...

WHEN `add-gap-and-rejection-ledgers-to-improve-harness` is implemented
THEN The report prints relevance per instruction id split by interactive and non-interactive sessions.
